question: How many claims in the North region are still open?

report.interpretation: Count of claims in the North region (OH, IL, NY) with status 'open' as of the extract date 2026-09-30, across all loss dates and products. This uses the agreed open_claims metric.
report.answer: 126 claims in the North region are still open as of 2026-09-30. Claims reported in the most recent weeks are incomplete because of late reporting, so this count will rise as more claims come in.
report.answer_sql: SELECT region, count(*) AS open_claims FROM claims WHERE region='North' AND status='open' GROUP BY region

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT region, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS value
FROM source
WHERE region IN ('North')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
